name: Sythrex Conclave
notes: Genetic Perfectionists. Mastered genetic engineering — created entire ecosystems and possibly uplifted lesser species; left behind massive seed vaults holding organisms extinct everywhere else. May have been wiped out by their own creations (hostile specialized bioforms found in their abandoned habitats). Status extinct.
